blocks.zh: 第三章：風險管理 — 生物製藥設施設計的科學基礎
blocks.en: Chapter 3: Risk Management - The Scientific Basis of Biopharmaceutical Facility Design

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解風險管理 (Risk Management) 在生物製藥製造中的核心地位，以及為何它是設施設計的基礎而非附屬工具
blocks.en: Understand the central role of risk management in biopharmaceutical manufacturing, and why it is the foundation of facility design rather than an add-on tool

blocks.zh: 掌握風險的定義：風險 = 概率 (Probability) × 影響嚴重性 (Severity) × 可偵測性 (Detectability)，並能應用於設施設計決策
blocks.en: Master the definition of risk: risk = probability × severity × detectability, and apply it to facility design decisions

blocks.zh: 理解 FDA 2004 年「21世紀 cGMP 風險管理方法」報告的核心理念，及其對現代生物製藥設施設計的影響
blocks.en: Understand the core philosophy of the FDA's 2004 report "Pharmaceutical CGMPs for the 21st Century: A Risk-Based Approach" and its influence on modern biopharmaceutical facility design

blocks.zh: 深入了解五種主要的風險評估工具（PHA、FMEA、FTA、HAZOPS、HACCP），能夠判斷在不同情境下各方法的適用性
blocks.en: Gain an in-depth understanding of the five main risk assessment tools (PHA, FMEA, FTA, HAZOPS, HACCP) and judge when each is appropriate

blocks.zh: 掌握 HACCP 七大原則在生物製藥製程中的應用邏輯，並能與第四章（製程密閉）和第六章（cGMP 佈局）的設計決策建立連結
blocks.en: Master the logic of applying the seven HACCP principles to biopharmaceutical processes, and link them to the design decisions in Chapter 4 (process containment) and Chapter 6 (cGMP layout)

blocks.zh: 3.1 Introduction 導論
blocks.en: 3.1 Introduction

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 — 本章的雙重目標
blocks.en: Core Concept - The Two Goals of This Chapter

blocks.zh: 第3章的導論段落雖然簡短，但明確了兩個關鍵訊息：
blocks.en: The introductory paragraph of Chapter 3 is short, but it makes two key points clear:

blocks.zh: 目標1：聚焦兩種污染來源
blocks.en: Goal 1: Focus on two sources of contamination

blocks.zh: 交叉污染 (Cross contamination)：來自其他產品、批次或步驟的污染物進入當前製程
blocks.en: Cross contamination: contaminants from other products, batches or steps entering the current process

blocks.zh: 環境污染 (Contamination from environment)：來自周圍廠房環境（空氣、表面、人員）的污染
blocks.en: Contamination from environment: contamination from the surrounding facility environment (air, surfaces, personnel)

blocks.zh: 這兩種污染源直接決定了你對設施的設計要求：如果你能密閉製程，環境污染風險就大幅降低；如果你在多產品廠房中，交叉污染就是首要關注點。
blocks.en: These two sources directly determine your facility design requirements: if you can close the process, the risk of environmental contamination drops sharply; if you work in a multi-product facility, cross contamination is the primary concern.

blocks.zh: 目標2：科學導向的設計決策
blocks.en: Goal 2: Science-based design decisions

blocks.zh: 控制措施的程度應與風險「相稱 (commensurate)」——這是 ICH Q9 品質風險管理 (Quality Risk Management, QRM) 的核心原則。不要過度設計（浪費資源），也不要設計不足（危及品質）。
blocks.en: Control measures should be "commensurate" with the risk - this is the core principle of ICH Q9 Quality Risk Management (QRM). Do not over-engineer (a waste of resources), and do not under-engineer (a threat to quality).

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — GDP 與製程理解的「版本控制」
blocks.en: Key Point - "Versioning" of GDP and Process Understanding

blocks.zh: 指南提到良好文件管理規範 (Good Documentation Practice, GDP) 中的「版本控制 (versioning)」概念，這比表面看起來更有深度：
blocks.en: The guide mentions the concept of "versioning" under Good Documentation Practice (GDP), which is deeper than it first appears:

blocks.zh: 生物製程的理解是隨時間積累的——臨床一期的理解遠少於商業化階段。指南建議隨著製程理解的深化，風險評估文件也應隨之更新和版本化。這個原則直接對應 ICH Q10 藥品品質體系中的「持續改進 (Continual Improvement)」概念。
blocks.en: Understanding of a biological process accumulates over time - understanding at Phase 1 clinical is far less than at the commercial stage. The guide recommends that risk assessment documents be updated and versioned as process understanding deepens. This principle corresponds directly to the "Continual Improvement" concept in the ICH Q10 pharmaceutical quality system.

blocks.zh: 對於 CDMO 而言，這意味著：接手新客戶的技術轉移時，早期的風險評估可能需要在製程充分理解後重新評估和更新。
blocks.en: For a CDMO, this means that when taking over a technology transfer from a new client, early risk assessments may need to be re-evaluated and updated once the process is fully understood.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 — 風險管理就像飛行前的安全檢查
blocks.en: Analogy - Risk Management Is Like a Preflight Safety Check

blocks.zh: 飛行員在每次飛行前都必須進行系統性的安全檢查（preflight checklist），即使是同一架飛機飛了一千次也不例外。這不是因為他們認為會出問題，而是因為系統性的風險識別是防止意外的唯一可靠方法。
blocks.en: Pilots must carry out a systematic safety check (preflight checklist) before every flight, even on an aircraft that has flown a thousand times. It is not because they expect something to go wrong, but because systematic risk identification is the only reliable way to prevent accidents.

blocks.zh: 生物製藥的風險管理也是如此：不能依靠「我們以前都這樣做沒出問題」的經驗法則，而必須有系統性的方法來識別、評估和控制每一個風險點。這是 FDA 2004 年報告的核心精神。
blocks.en: Biopharmaceutical risk management works the same way: you cannot rely on the rule of thumb "we have always done it this way without problems"; you need a systematic method to identify, assess and control every risk point. This is the core spirit of the FDA's 2004 report.

blocks.zh: 練習思考
blocks.en: Discussion Questions

blocks.zh: 「控制措施應與風險相稱」這個原則如何防止設計過度？舉一個生物製藥廠房設計中可能「過度設計」的例子，以及如何用風險評估工具避免它。
blocks.en: How does the principle "control measures should be commensurate with the risk" prevent over-design? Give an example of possible "over-design" in biopharmaceutical facility design, and how a risk assessment tool can avoid it.

blocks.zh: 本節提到兩種污染類型。在密閉系統的製程中，哪種污染類型依然需要關注？為什麼密閉不能消除所有污染風險？
blocks.en: This section mentions two types of contamination. In a closed-system process, which type still needs attention? Why can't closure eliminate all contamination risk?

blocks.zh: 3.2 Risk Management 風險管理
blocks.en: 3.2 Risk Management

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 — FDA 2004 年報告的歷史意義
blocks.en: Core Concept - The Historical Significance of the FDA's 2004 Report

blocks.zh: FDA 2004 年的「21世紀 cGMP：風險管理方法」報告是製藥監管史上的一個重要轉折點。在此之前，FDA 的稽查方式更偏向「規範性」（prescriptive）——嚴格按照法規條文逐條核查合規性。
blocks.en: The FDA's 2004 report "Pharmaceutical CGMPs for the 21st Century: A Risk-Based Approach" was an important turning point in pharmaceutical regulatory history. Before it, FDA inspections leaned toward the "prescriptive" - checking compliance clause by clause against the regulations.

blocks.zh: 這份報告開啟了「科學與風險導向」（science and risk-based）稽查的新時代，其核心主張是：
blocks.en: The report opened a new era of "science and risk-based" inspection, with these core claims:

blocks.zh: 製藥廠應該理解自己的製程，而不只是遵守規定
blocks.en: Pharmaceutical manufacturers should understand their own processes, not merely follow the rules

blocks.zh: FDA 稽查員應聚焦於真正的品質風險，而非僅僅文件格式
blocks.en: FDA investigators should focus on real quality risks, not just document format

blocks.zh: 新技術（如 PAT — 製程分析技術）應被鼓勵，而非因「改變」而受到阻礙
blocks.en: New technologies (such as PAT - process analytical technology) should be encouraged, not blocked simply because they involve "change"

blocks.zh: 持續改進（continuous improvement）應是正常的製造文化
blocks.en: Continuous improvement should be a normal part of manufacturing culture

blocks.zh: 這份報告直接促成了後來 ICH Q8、Q9、Q10（質量三部曲）的誕生，也奠定了現代 QbD 方法論的基礎。
blocks.en: This report directly led to ICH Q8, Q9 and Q10 (the quality trilogy), and laid the foundation of modern QbD methodology.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 藥品製造的變更為何如此高風險
blocks.en: Key Point - Why Changes in Drug Manufacturing Carry High Risk

blocks.zh: 指南開頭強調「製造變更伴隨高風險」，這對生物製藥尤其重要，因為：
blocks.en: The guide opens by stressing that "manufacturing changes carry high risk", which matters especially for biopharmaceuticals because:

blocks.zh: 製程即產品：對小分子藥物，你可以通過分析確認結構不變；但對生物製藥，蛋白質的折疊方式、糖基化模式可能因製程微小變化而改變，而這些變化可能影響安全性或療效
blocks.en: The process is the product: for a small-molecule drug, analysis can confirm that the structure is unchanged; for a biopharmaceutical, protein folding and glycosylation patterns can change with minor process changes, and those changes may affect safety or efficacy

blocks.zh: 「結構」難以完整表徵：一個 150 kDa 的 MAb 分子遠比一個 500 Da 的小分子複雜，無法用簡單的化學分析完整表徵
blocks.en: The "structure" is hard to characterize fully: a 150 kDa MAb molecule is far more complex than a 500 Da small molecule and cannot be fully characterized by simple chemical analysis

blocks.zh: CAPA 的重要性：當任何偏差發生時，CAPA（矯正與預防措施）必須包含風險評估，評估該偏差是否可能影響產品品質
blocks.en: The importance of CAPA: whenever a deviation occurs, the CAPA (corrective and preventive action) must include a risk assessment of whether the deviation could affect product quality

blocks.zh: FDA 的「科學導向稽查」和傳統「規範性稽查」在實際操作中有什麼不同？哪種方式對創新更有利？
blocks.en: How does the FDA's "science-based inspection" differ in practice from traditional "prescriptive inspection"? Which approach is better for innovation?

blocks.zh: 如果一個 CDMO 想要更換一個生物反應器供應商（相同規格但不同品牌），這屬於「製造變更」嗎？需要進行什麼層級的風險評估？
blocks.en: If a CDMO wants to change its bioreactor supplier (same specification, different brand), does this count as a "manufacturing change"? What level of risk assessment is needed?

blocks.zh: 3.2.1 Purpose of Risk Management 風險管理的目的
blocks.en: 3.2.1 Purpose of Risk Management

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 — 風險的三個維度
blocks.en: Core Concept - The Three Dimensions of Risk

blocks.zh: 指南定義的風險概念與 ICH Q9 一致，但隱含了三個維度（FMEA 的基礎）：
blocks.en: The risk concept defined in the guide is consistent with ICH Q9, but it implies three dimensions (the basis of FMEA):

blocks.zh: 風險 (Risk) = 概率 (Probability) × 嚴重性 (Severity) × 可偵測性 (Detectability) 的函數
blocks.en: Risk = a function of probability × severity × detectability

blocks.zh: 概率 (Probability/Likelihood)：該危害發生的可能性有多大？（頻率、歷史數據）
blocks.en: Probability/Likelihood: how likely is the hazard to occur? (frequency, historical data)

blocks.zh: 嚴重性 (Severity/Impact)：如果發生了，對患者或產品品質的影響有多嚴重？
blocks.en: Severity/Impact: if it occurs, how serious is the impact on the patient or product quality?

blocks.zh: 可偵測性 (Detectability)：如果發生了，我們能在造成傷害之前偵測到嗎？
blocks.en: Detectability: if it occurs, can we detect it before it causes harm?

blocks.zh: 這三個維度共同構成 FMEA 中的 Risk Priority Number (RPN) = S × O × D（嚴重性 × 發生率 × 可偵測性）。
blocks.en: Together these three dimensions form the Risk Priority Number (RPN) = S × O × D in FMEA (severity × occurrence × detectability).

blocks.zh: 公式與框架 — 風險優先數 (Risk Priority Number, RPN)
blocks.en: Formula and Framework - Risk Priority Number (RPN)

blocks.zh:
FMEA 風險評估公式：
RPN = Severity (S) × Occurrence (O) × Detection (D)

評分範例（各維度 1-10 分）：
S：嚴重性 1=可忽略, 10=致命
O：發生率 1=極少, 10=常見
D：可偵測性 1=容易偵測, 10=幾乎無法偵測

舉例：細胞培養污染風險
S = 9 (污染導致批次報廢, 嚴重影響患者供應)
O = 3 (有密閉系統保護, 發生率低)
D = 4 (有線上監測可快速偵測)
RPN = 9 × 3 × 4 = 108

高 RPN → 需要額外的控制措施
低 RPN → 現有控制措施已足夠

設施設計如何影響 RPN：
- 採用密閉系統 → 降低 O（發生率）
- 安裝線上 pH/DO 監測 → 降低 D（可偵測性分數）
- 使用多重屏障 → 同時降低 O 和 D
blocks.en:
FMEA risk assessment formula:
RPN = Severity (S) × Occurrence (O) × Detection (D)

Scoring example (each dimension scored 1-10):
S: Severity 1 = negligible, 10 = fatal
O: Occurrence 1 = very rare, 10 = common
D: Detectability 1 = easy to detect, 10 = almost undetectable

Example: cell culture contamination risk
S = 9 (contamination causes batch loss, seriously affecting patient supply)
O = 3 (protected by a closed system, low occurrence)
D = 4 (online monitoring allows rapid detection)
RPN = 9 × 3 × 4 = 108

High RPN → additional control measures needed
Low RPN → existing control measures are sufficient

How facility design affects RPN:
- Adopt a closed system → lowers O (occurrence)
- Install online pH/DO monitoring → lowers D (detection score)
- Use multiple barriers → lowers both O and D

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 「風險最終歸結於患者」是設計的最高原則
blocks.en: Key Point - "Risk Ultimately Comes Down to the Patient" Is the Highest Design Principle

blocks.zh: 指南強調風險管理的最終目標是「pro-actively mitigate the risk... to patient（主動降低對患者的風險）」。這句話應該被所有生物製藥設施設計者銘記在心。
blocks.en: The guide stresses that the ultimate goal of risk management is to "pro-actively mitigate the risk... to patient". Every biopharmaceutical facility designer should keep this sentence in mind.

blocks.zh: 這對應了我們在 PROMPT.md 中提到的設計決策階層：
blocks.en: This corresponds to the design decision hierarchy we described in PROMPT.md:

blocks.zh: 1. 無菌保證 / 患者安全
blocks.en: 1. Sterility assurance / patient safety

blocks.zh: 2. 產品 CQA（品質屬性）
blocks.en: 2. Product CQAs (quality attributes)

blocks.zh: 3. 商業彈性與成本效益
blocks.en: 3. Commercial flexibility and cost-effectiveness

blocks.zh: 當設計選擇與患者安全衝突時，安全永遠優先。風險管理工具的作用是讓這個優先順序有科學依據，而不是主觀判斷。
blocks.en: When a design choice conflicts with patient safety, safety always comes first. The role of risk management tools is to give this order of priority a scientific basis rather than leaving it to subjective judgment.

blocks.zh: 如果一個細胞培養步驟發生污染，RPN 極高。有兩個改善方案：A) 將環境升級到更高潔淨等級；B) 將開放製程改為密閉系統。從「降低 RPN 哪個維度」的角度分析兩個方案的差異。
blocks.en: If a cell culture step becomes contaminated, the RPN is very high. There are two improvement options: A) upgrade the environment to a higher cleanliness grade; B) convert the open process to a closed system. Analyze the difference between the two options in terms of which RPN dimension each reduces.

blocks.zh: 「可偵測性」是 RPN 中常被忽略的維度。設施設計上，有哪些具體措施可以提高對潛在污染的「可偵測性」？（提示：監測系統、取樣點設計）
blocks.en: "Detectability" is the most often overlooked dimension of the RPN. In facility design, what specific measures can improve the detectability of potential contamination? (Hint: monitoring systems, sampling point design)

blocks.zh: 3.2.2 Complying with the FDA's Commitment to Process Improvement and Science-Based Compliance 3.2.2 遵循 FDA 對製程改善與科學導向法規遵循的承諾
blocks.en: 3.2.2 Complying with the FDA's Commitment to Process Improvement and Science-Based Compliance

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 — FDA 聲明的四個關鍵訊息
blocks.en: Core Concept - Four Key Messages in the FDA Statement

blocks.zh: 仔細解讀 FDA 這段聲明，可以提取出四個對生物製藥設施設計至關重要的訊息：
blocks.en: Reading the FDA statement carefully, we can extract four messages that are critical to biopharmaceutical facility design:

blocks.zh: 「鼓勵新技術」：FDA 明確支持 PAT（製程分析技術）和持續改進。這意味著設施設計應為未來的技術升級預留彈性（例如，為 PAT 感測器設計安裝介面）
blocks.en: "Encouraging new technology": the FDA explicitly supports PAT (process analytical technology) and continuous improvement. This means facility design should leave flexibility for future technology upgrades (for example, designing installation interfaces for PAT sensors)

blocks.zh: 「製造是科學，不是藝術」：傳統上，製藥被認為是「按照配方操作」的藝術。FDA 要求轉型為基於科學理解的工程活動。這要求更深入的製程表徵和文件化
blocks.en: "Manufacturing is science, not art": pharmaceutical manufacturing was traditionally seen as an art of "following the recipe". The FDA requires a shift to an engineering activity based on scientific understanding. This calls for deeper process characterization and documentation

blocks.zh: 「降低變異性是品質與生產力的共同目標」：過去常被視為對立的「品質」和「效率」，在風險管理框架下找到了共同語言——降低製程變異性既能提升品質，又能減少廢品和返工，降低成本
blocks.en: "Reducing variability is a shared goal of quality and productivity": "quality" and "efficiency", often seen as opposed in the past, find common ground in the risk management framework - reducing process variability both improves quality and reduces waste and rework, lowering cost

blocks.zh: 「品質系統方法」：不是孤立的 SOP，而是整合性的品質管理系統（ICH Q10）
blocks.en: "A quality systems approach": not isolated SOPs, but an integrated quality management system (ICH Q10)

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 — 依照食材敏感度選擇廚房設計
blocks.en: Analogy - Choosing a Kitchen Design Based on Ingredient Sensitivity

blocks.zh: 想像你是一位米其林主廚，需要設計一個能同時處理生魚片（高度敏感，需嚴格溫度控制、分隔砧板）和烤肉（可以在高溫環境中作業）的廚房。
blocks.en: Imagine you are a Michelin-starred chef designing a kitchen that must handle both sashimi (highly sensitive, needing strict temperature control and separate cutting boards) and grilled meat (which can be handled in a high-heat environment).

blocks.zh: 你不會讓整個廚房都達到生魚片處理的最高衛生標準——那太昂貴了。你也不會讓生魚片和烤肉共用同一個砧板——那太危險了。
blocks.en: You would not bring the whole kitchen up to the highest hygiene standard for sashimi - that would be too expensive. Nor would you let sashimi and grilled meat share a cutting board - that would be too dangerous.

blocks.zh: 正確的做法是：根據每種食材的敏感度（風險等級），設計對應的操作區域和控制措施。這正是生物製藥設施設計的邏輯：根據每個製程步驟的風險評估結果，決定對應的環境等級和控制策略。
blocks.en: The right approach is to design work areas and control measures according to the sensitivity (risk level) of each ingredient. This is exactly the logic of biopharmaceutical facility design: based on the risk assessment result of each process step, decide the corresponding environmental grade and control strategy.

blocks.zh: 密閉系統 = 把食材完全密封在真空包裝中，不管外部廚房環境如何，食材都不受影響。
blocks.en: Closed system = sealing the ingredient completely in vacuum packaging, so it is unaffected by the surrounding kitchen environment.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 密閉製程的三個驗證要求
blocks.en: Key Point - Three Verification Requirements for Closed Processes

blocks.zh: 指南的結論段落非常重要，指出密閉製程成功實施的關鍵是三個層次的確認：
blocks.en: The concluding paragraph of the guide is very important; it indicates that successful implementation of a closed process depends on confirmation at three levels:

blocks.zh: Demonstration（展示）：在設計/研發階段，用實驗或工程分析證明系統在概念上是密閉的
blocks.en: Demonstration: at the design/development stage, show by experiment or engineering analysis that the system is closed in concept

blocks.zh: Validation（驗證）：正式驗證程序，證明密閉系統在規定的操作條件下能持續維持密閉性
blocks.en: Validation: a formal validation program proving that the closed system consistently maintains closure under the specified operating conditions

blocks.zh: Confirmation（確認）：持續的日常監測和定期再確認，確保系統未發生退化
blocks.en: Confirmation: ongoing routine monitoring and periodic reconfirmation to ensure the system has not degraded

blocks.zh: 這三個層次對應到設施生命週期的三個階段：設計→建設/調試→日常運營。每個階段都需要風險管理文件的支持。
blocks.en: These three levels correspond to three stages of the facility lifecycle: design → construction/commissioning → routine operation. Each stage needs the support of risk management documentation.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 — PAT 在生物製藥廠房設計中的具體意義
blocks.en: Practical Application - What PAT Means in Biopharmaceutical Facility Design

blocks.zh: FDA 在 2004 年報告中提到的 PAT（製程分析技術）在今天已經相當成熟。對於生物製藥 CDMO，設施設計中應考慮：
blocks.en: The PAT (process analytical technology) mentioned in the FDA's 2004 report is now quite mature. For a biopharmaceutical CDMO, facility design should consider:

blocks.zh: 線上監測點：在細胞培養生物反應器中安裝 pH、溶氧 (DO)、二氧化碳、生物量（Biomass）等線上感測器
blocks.en: Online monitoring points: install online sensors for pH, dissolved oxygen (DO), carbon dioxide and biomass in cell culture bioreactors

blocks.zh: 實時放行（RTRT）：用持續的製程數據代替批次終點的抽樣檢驗，這需要設施設計預留數據採集和分析系統的介面
blocks.en: Real-time release (RTRT): replace end-of-batch sampling and testing with continuous process data, which requires the facility design to reserve interfaces for data acquisition and analysis systems

blocks.zh: 自動化和數位化：設施設計應考慮未來系統整合（例如 MES 製程執行系統、DCS 分散控制系統）的佈線和網路基礎設施
blocks.en: Automation and digitalization: facility design should plan the cabling and network infrastructure for future system integration (such as MES manufacturing execution systems and DCS distributed control systems)

blocks.zh: PAT 不只是分析技術，它要求設施設計從一開始就考慮「如何監測、如何傳輸數據、如何做決策」的全鏈路設計。
blocks.en: PAT is not just an analytical technology; it requires facility design to consider, from the start, the full chain of "how to monitor, how to transmit data, how to make decisions".

blocks.zh: FDA 說「降低變異性是品質和生產力的共同目標」。請舉一個設施設計決策的例子，說明它如何同時降低品質風險和提升生產效率。
blocks.en: The FDA says "reducing variability is a shared goal of quality and productivity". Give an example of a facility design decision that both reduces quality risk and improves production efficiency.

blocks.zh: 密閉製程需要「驗證」才算成立。如果你的密閉系統包含一個單次使用生物袋（single-use bag），驗證應該包含哪些測試？（提示：完整性測試、萃取物/析出物）
blocks.en: A closed process must be "validated" to be considered closed. If your closed system includes a single-use bag, which tests should the validation include? (Hint: integrity testing, extractables/leachables)

blocks.zh: 3.2.3 Methods and Approaches to Assessing Risk 風險評估的方法與工具
blocks.en: 3.2.3 Methods and Approaches to Assessing Risk

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 — 風險工具就像不同功能的工具箱
blocks.en: Analogy - Risk Tools Are Like a Toolbox of Different Functions

blocks.zh: 如果設施設計是建造一棟房子，這五種風險工具就像工具箱裡的不同工具：
blocks.en: If facility design is like building a house, the five risk tools are like the different tools in a toolbox:

blocks.zh: PHA = 勘地工具：開工前快速評估地塊有什麼問題（土質、日照、排水），決定哪些需要深入調查
blocks.en: PHA = site survey tool: before construction, quickly assess what problems the plot has (soil, sunlight, drainage) and decide which need deeper investigation

blocks.zh: FMEA = 建材質量清單：逐一評估每種建材可能的故障模式（鋼筋會生鏽嗎？混凝土強度足夠嗎？），計算每個問題的嚴重性
blocks.en: FMEA = building materials quality checklist: assess the possible failure modes of each material one by one (will the rebar rust? is the concrete strong enough?) and calculate the severity of each problem

blocks.zh: FTA = 出了問題後的根因分析：如果牆壁出現裂縫，倒過來追溯所有可能導致裂縫的原因
blocks.en: FTA = root cause analysis after something goes wrong: if a crack appears in the wall, trace backwards through all the possible causes of the crack

blocks.zh: HAZOPS = 水電配管審查：逐一審查每段管線，問「如果壓力太高/太低/流向反了，會怎樣？」
blocks.en: HAZOPS = plumbing and electrical piping review: review each pipe section one by one, asking "what happens if the pressure is too high/too low/the flow is reversed?"

blocks.zh: HACCP = 廚房食品安全計畫：找出關鍵控制點（例如肉類烹調溫度），設定標準，制定監控程序
blocks.en: HACCP = kitchen food safety plan: find the critical control points (such as meat cooking temperature), set standards, and establish monitoring procedures

blocks.zh: 深度解析 — HACCP 在生物製藥設施設計中的應用
blocks.en: In-Depth Analysis - Applying HACCP to Biopharmaceutical Facility Design

blocks.zh: HACCP 來自食品工業，但其邏輯與生物製藥製程高度契合。讓我們用一個生物反應器培養步驟來說明 7 個原則的應用：
blocks.en: HACCP comes from the food industry, but its logic fits biopharmaceutical processes very well. Let us illustrate the application of the 7 principles with a bioreactor culture step:

blocks.zh: 原則1 危害分析：識別細胞培養中的潛在危害（微生物污染、病毒污染、代謝副產物累積等），使用 PFD 逐步分析每個輸入和輸出
blocks.en: Principle 1 Hazard analysis: identify potential hazards in cell culture (microbial contamination, viral contamination, accumulation of metabolic by-products, etc.), and use the PFD to analyze each input and output step by step

blocks.zh: 原則2 確定 CCP：例如，生物反應器接種點是 CCP（接種必須在無菌條件下進行，任何失誤都可能導致整批報廢）
blocks.en: Principle 2 Determine CCPs: for example, the bioreactor inoculation point is a CCP (inoculation must be carried out under sterile conditions, and any error could cause loss of the whole batch)

blocks.zh: 原則3 建立關鍵限值：例如，接種環境必須在 ISO 5 或密閉系統條件下進行；接種前生物反應器 pH 必須在 6.8-7.2 範圍
blocks.en: Principle 3 Establish critical limits: for example, inoculation must be performed in an ISO 5 environment or under closed-system conditions; the bioreactor pH before inoculation must be within 6.8-7.2

blocks.zh: 原則4 監控程序：建立線上 pH/DO/生物量監測，定期取樣進行微生物限度測試
blocks.en: Principle 4 Monitoring procedures: establish online pH/DO/biomass monitoring, and take samples regularly for microbial limit testing

blocks.zh: 原則5 矯正措施：如果 pH 超出範圍，立即觸發酸/鹼添加；如果發現微生物污染，終止批次並啟動根因調查
blocks.en: Principle 5 Corrective actions: if pH goes out of range, immediately trigger acid/base addition; if microbial contamination is found, terminate the batch and start a root cause investigation

blocks.zh: 原則6 驗證程序：定期驗證監測系統的準確性，審核 HACCP 計畫的有效性
blocks.en: Principle 6 Verification procedures: periodically verify the accuracy of the monitoring system and review the effectiveness of the HACCP plan

blocks.zh: 原則7 文件記錄：所有監控數據、偏差、矯正措施都必須在批次記錄中完整記錄
blocks.en: Principle 7 Documentation: all monitoring data, deviations and corrective actions must be fully recorded in the batch record

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 本章與第4章和第6章的連結
blocks.en: Key Point - Links Between This Chapter and Chapters 4 and 6

blocks.zh: 第3章的風險評估工具是後續章節設計決策的「驅動引擎」：
blocks.en: The risk assessment tools in Chapter 3 are the "driving engine" of the design decisions in later chapters:

blocks.zh: 連接第4章（製程密閉）：FMEA/HACCP 的結果告訴你哪些製程步驟的環境污染風險高 → 這些步驟需要密閉或更嚴格的環境控制。反之，已密閉的步驟可以降低對環境等級的要求。
blocks.en: Link to Chapter 4 (process containment): the results of FMEA/HACCP tell you which process steps carry a high risk of environmental contamination → these steps need closure or stricter environmental control. Conversely, steps that are already closed can have lower environmental grade requirements.

blocks.zh: 連接第6章（cGMP 廠房佈局）：HAZOPS 通常以 P&ID 為基礎 → 要做 HAZOPS 就需要先有製程設計。廠房佈局必須支持 HACCP 中識別的 CCP 的監控要求（例如，CCP 附近需要設計取樣口）。
blocks.en: Link to Chapter 6 (cGMP facility layout): HAZOPS is usually based on the P&ID → to do a HAZOPS you first need the process design. The facility layout must support the monitoring requirements of the CCPs identified in HACCP (for example, sampling ports need to be designed near a CCP).

blocks.zh: 理解這個鏈結關係，才能理解為何 ISPE Vol.6 的章節順序是：法規 → 風險管理 → 製程密閉 → 設施佈局。這是一個由分析到設計的邏輯流程，而非隨意排列。
blocks.en: Understanding this chain explains why the chapters of ISPE Vol.6 run in the order: regulation → risk management → process containment → facility layout. It is a logical flow from analysis to design, not an arbitrary arrangement.

blocks.zh: 比較框架 — FMEA vs. HACCP 在設施設計中的角色
blocks.en: Comparison Framework - The Roles of FMEA vs. HACCP in Facility Design

blocks.zh:
FMEA — 最適用於設備和系統設計評估
輸入：設備清單 + 製程步驟
輸出：RPN 排序表 + 需改善的高風險點

應用範例：
- 評估無菌過濾膜的故障模式
- 評估生物反應器攪拌系統的失效風險
- 評估 CIP/SIP 系統的設計充分性

HACCP — 最適用於製程控制策略設計
輸入：PFD (製程流程圖) + 危害識別
輸出：CCP 清單 + 關鍵限值 + 監控計畫

應用範例：
- 確定接種點為 CCP，設定無菌條件要求
- 確定病毒不活化步驟為 CCP，設定 pH/溫度限值
- 確定最終過濾為 CCP，設定過濾前生物負荷限值

組合使用：先用 PHA 快速掃描 → 再用 FMEA 詳細分析
設備 → 再用 HACCP 建立製程控制體系
blocks.en:
FMEA - best suited to equipment and system design assessment
Input: equipment list + process steps
Output: RPN ranking table + high-risk points needing improvement

Application examples:
- Assess failure modes of a sterilizing filter membrane
- Assess failure risks of the bioreactor agitation system
- Assess the design adequacy of CIP/SIP systems

HACCP - best suited to process control strategy design
Input: PFD (process flow diagram) + hazard identification
Output: CCP list + critical limits + monitoring plan

Application examples:
- Determine the inoculation point as a CCP and set sterile condition requirements
- Determine the virus inactivation step as a CCP and set pH/temperature limits
- Determine the final filtration as a CCP and set a pre-filtration bioburden limit

Combined use: first scan quickly with PHA → then analyze equipment in detail with FMEA → then build the process control system with HACCP

blocks.zh: 實務應用 — CDMO 承接新品種的風險評估流程
blocks.en: Practical Application - Risk Assessment Workflow for a CDMO Taking On a New Product

blocks.zh: 當一個 CDMO 承接一個新客戶的單株抗體 (MAb) 生產技術轉移時，風險評估的實際流程建議：
blocks.en: When a CDMO takes on a technology transfer for monoclonal antibody (MAb) production from a new client, the recommended practical risk assessment workflow is:

blocks.zh: 第1步 — PHA（項目啟動階段）：與客戶技術團隊開腦力激盪會議，快速識別這個特定分子的主要風險（例如：聚合體形成傾向高？對剪切力特別敏感？特殊的病毒清除要求？）
blocks.en: Step 1 - PHA (project initiation): hold a brainstorming session with the client's technical team to quickly identify the main risks of this specific molecule (for example: high tendency to form aggregates? particularly sensitive to shear? special viral clearance requirements?)

blocks.zh: 第2步 — FMEA（詳細設計階段）：針對計畫使用的設備（生物反應器、層析設備、過濾系統），逐一評估設備故障的風險，計算 RPN，決定是否需要升級設備或增加備援設計
blocks.en: Step 2 - FMEA (detailed design): for the planned equipment (bioreactors, chromatography equipment, filtration systems), assess the risk of equipment failure one by one, calculate the RPN, and decide whether equipment upgrades or redundant designs are needed

blocks.zh: 第3步 — HAZOPS（P&ID 審查階段）：對設計好的管線系統進行系統性審查，確保所有可能的操作偏差都已被考慮並有對應的安全設計
blocks.en: Step 3 - HAZOPS (P&ID review): systematically review the designed piping systems to ensure that all possible operating deviations have been considered and have corresponding safety design

blocks.zh: 第4步 — HACCP（製程鎖定後）：建立完整的 HACCP 計畫，識別所有 CCP，設定關鍵限值，建立監控和矯正程序，作為批次記錄設計的基礎
blocks.en: Step 4 - HACCP (after the process is locked): establish a complete HACCP plan, identify all CCPs, set critical limits, and establish monitoring and corrective procedures as the basis for batch record design

blocks.zh: FMEA 「不考慮系統間的交互作用」。在多產品生物製藥廠房中，這個局限性可能導致什麼風險被低估？需要配合哪種工具才能補充這個不足？
blocks.en: FMEA "does not consider interactions between systems". In a multi-product biopharmaceutical facility, what risks might this limitation cause to be underestimated? Which tool is needed to make up for this gap?

blocks.zh: HACCP 的第5步是「建立矯正措施」。如果一個生物反應器的 pH 超出關鍵限值，矯正措施應包含哪些步驟？（考慮：立即行動、批次處置、根因調查、預防措施）
blocks.en: Step 5 of HACCP is "establish corrective actions". If the pH of a bioreactor goes beyond the critical limit, what steps should the corrective action include? (Consider: immediate action, batch disposition, root cause investigation, preventive action)

blocks.zh: 本指南鼓勵使用「混合平台 (hybrid platform)」進行風險評估。你認為 FMEA + HACCP 的組合在什麼情況下特別有效？舉一個具體的設施設計應用場景。
blocks.en: The guide encourages using a "hybrid platform" for risk assessment. In what situations do you think the combination of FMEA + HACCP is especially effective? Give a specific facility design application scenario.

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 — 五種風險評估工具的特性對比
blocks.en: Core Concept - Comparing the Characteristics of the Five Risk Assessment Tools

blocks.zh: 這五種工具各有其最適用的場景，選擇正確的工具至關重要：
blocks.en: Each of these five tools has its own best-fit scenarios, and choosing the right tool is critical:

blocks.zh: 本章重點回顧 Chapter Summary
blocks.en: Chapter Summary

blocks.zh: 風險管理是設施設計的科學基礎：品質風險管理 (QRM) 確保控制措施與風險相稱，避免過度設計或設計不足，所有設計決策都需要科學依據
blocks.en: Risk management is the scientific basis of facility design: quality risk management (QRM) ensures control measures are commensurate with the risk, avoiding over-design or under-design; all design decisions need a scientific basis

blocks.zh: 風險三維度框架：風險 = 概率 × 嚴重性 × 可偵測性（對應 FMEA 的 O × S × D = RPN）；設施設計措施可以降低這三個維度中的一個或多個
blocks.en: The three-dimension risk framework: risk = probability × severity × detectability (corresponding to O × S × D = RPN in FMEA); facility design measures can reduce one or more of the three dimensions

blocks.zh: FDA 2004 年報告奠定現代監管基礎：科學導向稽查、鼓勵新技術（PAT）、製程理解驅動合規、降低變異性是品質和生產力的共同目標
blocks.en: The FDA's 2004 report laid the foundation of modern regulation: science-based inspection, encouragement of new technology (PAT), compliance driven by process understanding, and reducing variability as a shared goal of quality and productivity

blocks.zh: 密閉製程的合規要求包含三層：Demonstration（展示）→ Validation（驗證）→ Confirmation（確認），需要文件化的風險評估支持
blocks.en: Compliance requirements for closed processes have three levels: Demonstration → Validation → Confirmation, supported by documented risk assessment

blocks.zh: 五種風險工具各有所長：PHA（早期掃描）→ FMEA（設備設計）→ FTA（根因分析）→ HAZOPS（P&ID 審查）→ HACCP（製程控制策略）；可混合使用
blocks.en: Each of the five risk tools has its strengths: PHA (early scan) → FMEA (equipment design) → FTA (root cause analysis) → HAZOPS (P&ID review) → HACCP (process control strategy); they can be combined

blocks.zh: HACCP 七大原則在生物製藥中完全適用：識別危害 → 確定 CCP → 設定限值 → 建立監控 → 制定矯正措施 → 驗證 → 文件化，這個框架構成批次記錄和製程管控 SOP 的骨架
blocks.en: The seven HACCP principles are fully applicable to biopharmaceuticals: identify hazards → determine CCPs → set limits → establish monitoring → define corrective actions → verify → document; this framework forms the backbone of batch records and process control SOPs

blocks.zh: 本章連結第4章和第6章：風險評估結果 → 決定製程密閉策略（第4章）→ 決定廠房環境分級和佈局（第6章）；三章形成完整的設計決策邏輯鏈
blocks.en: This chapter links to Chapters 4 and 6: risk assessment results → determine the process containment strategy (Chapter 4) → determine facility environmental classification and layout (Chapter 6); the three chapters form a complete logical chain of design decisions
